name: NoUnderlyingPaymentStubStartDateBusinessCenters
description: Number of business centers in the repeating group.

name: UnderlyingPaymentStubStartDateBusinessCenter
description:
The business center calendar used for date adjustment of the payment stub start date, e.g. "GBLO".
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

name: UnderlyingProvisionBreakFeeElection
description: Type of fee elected for the break provision.

name: UnderlyingProvisionBreakFeeRate
description: Break fee election rate when the break fee is proportional to the notional. A fee rate of 5% would be represented as "0.05".

name: UnderlyingRateSpreadInitialValue
description: Specifies the initial rate spread for a basket underlier.

name: NoUnderlyingRateSpreadSteps
description: Number of entries in the repeating group.

name: UnderlyingRateSpreadStepDate
description: The date that the rate spread step takes affect.

name: UnderlyingRateSpreadStepValue
description: The the value of the new rate spread as of the UnderlyingRateSpreadStepDate(43006).

name: NoUnderlyingReturnRateDates
description: Number of iterations in the return rate date repeating group.

name: UnderlyingReturnRateDateMode
description: Specifies the valuation type applicable to the return rate date.

name: UnderlyingReturnRateValuationDateRelativeTo
description:
Specifies the anchor date when the return rate valuation dates are relative to an anchor date.
See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

name: UnderlyingReturnRateValuationDateOffsetPeriod
description: Time unit multiplier for the relative return rate valuation date offset.

name: UnderlyingReturnRateValuationDateOffsetUnit
description: Time unit associated with the relative return rate valuation date offset.

name: UnderlyingReturnRateValuationDateOffsetDayType
description: Specifies the day type of the relative return rate valuation date offset.

name: UnderlyingReturnRateValuationStartDateUnadjusted
description: The unadjusted start date for return rate valuation. This can be used to restrict the range of dates when they are relative.

name: UnderlyingReturnRateValuationStartDateRelativeTo
description:
Specifies the anchor date when the return rate valuation start date is relative to an anchor date.
See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

name: UnderlyingReturnRateValuationStartDateOffsetPeriod
description: Time unit multiplier for the relative return rate valuation start date offset.

name: UnderlyingReturnRateValuationStartDateOffsetUnit
description: Time unit associated with the relative return rate valuation start date offset.

name: UnderlyingReturnRateValuationStartDateOffsetDayType
description: Specifies the day type of the relative return rate valuation start date offset.

name: UnderlyingReturnRateValuationStartDateAdjusted
description: The adjusted start date for return rate valuation. This can be used to restrict the range of dates when they are relative.

name: UnderlyingReturnRateValuationEndDateUnadjusted
description: The unadjusted end date for return rate valuation. This can be used to restrict the range of dates when they are relative.

name: UnderlyingReturnRateValuationEndDateRelativeTo
description:
Specifies the anchor date when the return rate valuation end date is relative to an anchor date.
See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

name: UnderlyingReturnRateValuationEndDateOffsetPeriod
description: Time unit multiplier for the relative return rate valuation end date offset.

name: UnderlyingReturnRateValuationEndDateOffsetUnit
description: Time unit associated with the relative return rate valuation end date offset.

name: UnderlyingReturnRateValuationEndDateOffsetDayType
description: Specifies the day type of the relative return rate valuation end date offset.

name: UnderlyingReturnRateValuationEndDateAdjusted
description: The adjusted end date for return rate valuation. This can be used to restrict the range of dates when they are relative.

name: UnderlyingReturnRateValuationFrequencyPeriod
description: Time unit multiplier for the frequency at which return rate valuation dates occur.

name: UnderlyingReturnRateValuationFrequencyUnit
description: Time unit associated with the frequency at which return rate valuation dates occur.

name: UnderlyingReturnRateValuationFrequencyRollConvention
description: The convention for determining the sequence of return rate valuation dates. It is used in conjunction with a specified frequency.

values.meaning: The floating rate note convention or Eurodollar convention.
The International Money Market settlement date, i.e. the 3rd Wednesday of the month.
The last trading day/expiration day of the Canadian Derivatives Exchange.
The last trading day of the Sydney Futures Exchange Australian 90-day bank accepted bill futures contract.
The last trading day of the Sydney Futures Exchange New Zealand 90-day bank bill futures contract.
The Sydney Futures Exchange 90-day bank accepted bill futures settlement dates.
The 13-week and 26-week U.S. Treasury Bill auction dates.

name: UnderlyingReturnRateValuationDateBusinessDayConvention
description: The return rate valuation dates business day convention.

name: NoUnderlyingReturnRateFXConversions
description: Number of iterations in the return rate FX conversion repeating group.

name: UnderlyingReturnRateFXCurrencySymbol
description: Specifies the currency pair for the FX conversion expressed using the CCY1/CCY2 convention. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

name: UnderlyingReturnRateFXRate
description: The rate of exchange between the two currencies specified in UnderlyingReturnRateFXCurrencySymbol(43031).

name: UnderlyingReturnRateFXRateCalc
description: Specifies whether UnderlyingReturnRateFXRate(43032) should be multiplied or divided.

name: NoUnderlyingReturnRates
description: Number of iterations in the return rate repeating group.

name: UnderlyingReturnRatePriceSequence
description: Specifies the type of price sequence of the return rate.

name: UnderlyingReturnRateCommissionBasis
description: Specifies the basis or unit used to calculate the commission.

name: UnderlyingReturnRateCommissionAmount
description: The commission amount.

name: UnderlyingReturnRateCommissionCurrency
description: Specifies the currency the commission amount is denominated in. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

name: UnderlyingReturnRateTotalCommissionPerTrade
description: The total commission per trade.

name: UnderlyingReturnRateDeterminationMethod
description:
Specifies the method by which the underlier prices are determined.
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/determination-method for values.

name: UnderlyingReturnRateAmountRelativeTo
description:
Specifies the reference amount when the return rate amount is relative to another amount in the trade.
See https://fixtrading.org/packages/payment-amount-relative-to for code list of relative amounts.

name: UnderlyingReturnRateQuoteMeasureType
description:
Specifies the type of the measure applied to the return rate's asset, e.g. valuation, sensitivity risk. This could be an NPV, a cash flow, a clean price, etc.
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/asset-measure for values.

name: UnderlyingReturnRateQuoteUnits
description:
Specifies the units that the measure is expressed in. If not specified, the default is a price/value in currency units.
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/price-quote-units for values.

name: UnderlyingReturnRateQuoteMethod
description: Specifies the type of quote used to determine the return rate of the swap.

name: UnderlyingReturnRateQuoteCurrency
description: Specifies the currency the return rate quote is denominated in. Uses ISO 4217 Currency Code.

name: UnderlyingReturnRateQuoteCurrencyType
description:
Specifies the type of currency, e.g. settlement currency, base currency, etc., that the quote is reported in.
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/reporting-currency-type for values.

name: UnderlyingReturnRateQuoteTimeType
description: Specifies how or the timing when the quote is to be obtained.

values.meaning: As specified in the master confirmation

name: UnderlyingReturnRateQuoteTime
description: The time when the quote is to be generated.

name: UnderlyingReturnRateQuoteDate
description: The date when the quote is to be generated.

name: UnderlyingReturnRateQuoteExpirationTime
description: The time when the quote ceases to be valid.

name: UnderlyingReturnRateQuoteBusinessCenter
description:
The business center calendar used for adjustments associated with UnderlyingReturnRateQuoteTimeType(43047) or UnderlyingReturnRateQuoteTime(43048) and UnderlyingReturnRateQuoteDate(43049), e.g. "GBLO".
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

name: UnderlyingReturnRateQuoteExchange
description: Specifies the exchange (e.g. stock or listed futures/options exchange) from which the quote is obtained.

name: UnderlyingReturnRateQuotePricingModel
description:
Specifies the pricing model used to evaluate the underlying asset price.
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/pricing-model for values.

name: UnderlyingReturnRateCashFlowType
description:
Specifies the type of cash flows, e.g. coupon payment, premium fee, settlement fee, etc.
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/cashflow-type for values.

name: UnderlyingReturnRateValuationTimeType
description: Specifies the timing at which the calculation agent values the underlying.

values.meaning: As specified in the master confirmation

name: UnderlyingReturnRateValuationTime
description: The time at which the calculation agent values the underlying asset.

name: UnderlyingReturnRateValuationTimeBusinessCenter
description:
The business center calendar used for adjustments associated with UnderlyingReturnRateValuationTimeType(43055) or UnderlyingReturnRateValuationTime(43056) , e.g. "GBLO".
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

name: UnderlyingReturnRateValuationPriceOption
description: Indicates whether an ISDA price option applies, and if applicable which type of price.

name: UnderlyingReturnRateFinalPriceFallback
description: Specifies the fallback provision for the hedging party in the determination of the final price.

name: NoUnderlyingReturnRateInformationSources
description: Number of iterations in the return rate information source repeating group.

name: UnderlyingReturnRateInformationSource
description: Identifies the source of rate information. For FX the references source to be used for the FX spot rate.

name: UnderlyingReturnRateReferencePage
description:
Identifies the reference "page" from the rate source.
For FX, the reference page to the spot rate to be used for the reference FX spot rate.
When UnderlyingReturnRateInformationSource(43061) = 3 (ISDA Settlement Rate Option) this contains the value from the scheme that reflects the terms of the Annex A to the ISDA 1998 FX and Currency Option Definitions.
See: https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/settlement-rate-option

name: UnderlyingReturnRateReferencePageHeading
description: Identifies the page heading from the rate source.

name: NoUnderlyingReturnRatePrices
description: Number of iterations in the return rate price repeating group.

name: UnderlyingReturnRatePriceBasis
description: The basis of the return price.

name: UnderlyingReturnRatePrice
description: Specifies the price of the underlying swap asset.

name: UnderlyingReturnRatePriceCurrency
description: Specifies the currency of the price of the underlying swap asset. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

name: UnderlyingReturnRatePriceType
description: Specifies whether the UnderlyingReturnRatePrice(43066) is expressed in absolute or relative terms.

name: NoUnderlyingReturnRateValuationDateBusinessCenters
description: Number of iterations in the return rate valuation date business center repeating group.

name: UnderlyingReturnRateValuationDateBusinessCenter
description:
The business center calendar used for date adjustment of the return rate valuation unadjusted or relative dates, e.g. "GBLO".
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

name: NoUnderlyingReturnRateValuationDates
description: Number of iterations in the return rate valuation date repeating group.

name: UnderlyingReturnRateValuationDate
description: The return rate valuation date. Type of date is specified in UnderlyingReturnRateValuationDateType(43073).

name: UnderlyingReturnRateValuationDateType
description: Specifies the type of return rate valuation date (e.g. adjusted for holidays).

name: NoUnderlyingSettlMethodElectionDateBusinessCenters
description: Number of business centers in the repeating group.

name: UnderlyingSettlMethodElectionDateBusinessCenter
description:
The business center calendar used for date adjustment of the settlement method election unadjusted or relative date, e.g. "GBLO".
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

name: UnderlyingSettlMethodElectionDateUnadjusted
description: The unadjusted settlement method election date.

name: UnderlyingSettlMethodElectionDateBusinessDayConvention
description: The settlement method election date adjustment business day convention.

name: UnderlyingSettlMethodElectionDateRelativeTo
description:
Specifies the anchor date when the settlement method election date is relative to an anchor date.
See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

name: UnderlyingSettlMethodElectionDateOffsetPeriod
description: Time unit multiplier for the relative settlement method election date offset.

name: UnderlyingSettlMethodElectionDateOffsetUnit
description: Time unit associated with the relative settlement method election date offset.

name: UnderlyingSettlMethodElectionDateOffsetDayType
description: Specifies the day type of the relative settlement method election date offset.

name: UnderlyingSettlMethodElectionDateAdjusted
description: The adjusted settlement method election date.

name: UnderlyingStreamVersion
description: The stream version identifier when there have been modifications to the contract over time. Helps signal when there are embedded changes.

name: UnderlyingStreamVersionEffectiveDate
description: The effective date of the UnderlyingStreamVersion(43083).

name: UnderlyingStreamNotionalDeterminationMethod
description:
Specifies the method for determining the floating notional value for equity swaps.
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/determination-method for values.

name: UnderlyingStreamNotionalAdjustments
description: For equity swaps this specifies the conditions that govern the adjustment to the number of units of the swap.

name: PaymentDesc
description: A short descriptive name given to the payment, e.g. Premium, Upfront, etc. The description has no intrinsic meaning but should be arbitrarily chosen by the remitter as reference.

name: LegPaymentStreamRateIndexID
description: Security identifier of the floating rate index.

name: LegPaymentStreamRateIndexIDSource
description: Source for the floating rate index identified in LegPaymentStreamRateIndexID(43088).

values.meaning: Consolidated Tape Association (CTA) Symbol (SIAC CTS/CQS line format)

name: PaymentStreamRateIndexID
description: Security identifier of the floating rate index.

name: PaymentStreamRateIndexIDSource
description: Source for the floating rate index identified in PaymentStreamRateIndexID(43090).

values.meaning: Consolidated Tape Association (CTA) Symbol (SIAC CTS/CQS line format)

name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamRateIndexID
description: Security identifier of the floating rate index.

name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamRateIndexIDSource
description: Source for the floating rate index identified in UnderlyingPaymentStreamRateIndexID(43092).

values.meaning: Consolidated Tape Association (CTA) Symbol (SIAC CTS/CQS line format)

name: DeliveryStreamRouteOrCharter
description: Specific delivery route or time charter average. Applicable to commodity freight swaps.

name: LegDeliveryStreamRouteOrCharter
description: Specific delivery route or time charter average. Applicable to commodity freight swaps.

name: UnderlyingDeliveryStreamRouteOrCharter
description: Specific delivery route or time charter average. Applicable to commodity freight swaps.

name: PaymentFixedRate
description: The rate applicable to the fixed rate payment.

name: PaymentFloatingRateIndex
description: The payment floating rate index. See SpreadOrBenchmarkCurveData(221) for suggested values.

name: PaymentFloatingRateIndexCurvePeriod
description: Time unit multiplier for the floating rate index.

name: PaymentFloatingRateIndexCurveUnit
description: Time unit associated with the floating rate index.

name: PaymentFloatingRateSpread
description: Spread from floating rate index.

name: PaymentFrequencyPeriod
description: Time unit multiplier for the payment frequency.

name: PaymentFrequencyUnit
description: Time unit associated with the payment frequency.

name: PaymentRateResetFrequencyPeriod
description: Time unit multiplier for the floating rate reset frequency.

name: PaymentRateResetFrequencyUnit
description: Time unit associated with the floating rate reset frequency.

name: PaymentStreamOtherDayCount
description: The industry name of the day count convention not listed in PaymentStreamDayCount(40742).

name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamOtherDayCount
description: The industry name of the day count convention not listed in UnderlyingPaymentStreamDayCount(40572).

name: LegPaymentStreamOtherDayCount
description: The industry name of the day count convention not listed in LegPaymentStreamDayCount(40283).

name: PaymentStreamFormulaLength
description: Byte length of encoded (non-ASCII characters) PaymentStreamFormula(42648) field.

name: LegPaymentStreamFormulaLength
description: Byte length of encoded (non-ASCII characters) LegPaymentStreamFormula(42486) field.

name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamFormulaLength
description: Byte length of encoded (non-ASCII characters) UnderlyingPaymentStreamFormula(42982) field.

name: PaymentStreamRateIndex2
description: The payment stream's second floating rate index.

name: PaymentStreamRateIndex2Source
description: The source of the payment stream's second floating rate index.

name: PaymentStreamRateIndex2ID
description: Security identifier of the second floating rate index.

name: PaymentStreamRateIndex2IDSource
description: Source for the second floating rate index identified in PaymentStreamRateIndex2ID(43114).

values.meaning: Consolidated Tape Association (CTA) Symbol (SIAC CTS/CQS line format)

name: LegPaymentStreamRateIndex2
description: The payment stream's second floating rate index.

name: LegPaymentStreamRateIndex2Source
description: The source of the payment stream's second floating rate index.

name: LegPaymentStreamRateIndex2ID
description: Security identifier of the second floating rate index.

name: LegPaymentStreamRateIndex2IDSource
description: Source for the second floating rate index identified in LegPaymentStreamRateIndex2ID(43118).

values.meaning: Consolidated Tape Association (CTA) Symbol (SIAC CTS/CQS line format)

name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamRateIndex2
description: The payment stream's second floating rate index.

name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamRateIndex2Source
description: The source of the payment stream's second floating rate index.

name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamRateIndex2ID
description: Security identifier of the second floating rate index.

name: UnderlyingPaymentStreamRateIndex2IDSource
description: Source for the second floating rate index identified in UnderlyingPaymentStreamRateIndex2ID(43122).
